annotations.title: Download a document by record id

description:
Download the file as stored for one record — not PipesHub's parsed
content, metadata header, or summary.

Use this when the user wants the file itself (download, attach, open).

Do not use this to read, summarize, or answer "what does this doc
say?" regardless of format. That is `pipeshub_get_record_content`
`mode:"content"`. Text formats come back inline; images, audio, and
binary as base64.

`convertTo` accepts only `application/pdf`; anything else is ignored.
At most 100,000 characters come back.

convertTo.description: The only conversion target connectors honour is `application/pdf` (the MIME type, not `pdf`). A bare `pdf` is ignored and the original file is returned with no error. Omit for the file as stored. Does not parse the document — use `pipeshub_get_record_content` `mode:"content"` for that.

maxChars.description: Most characters to return (text, or base64 for a file). Default 100,000, about 25k tokens. Raise it only to save the file to disk, never to read it. With it set, a text file over the cap is refused rather than cut.

recordId.description: Record identifier — usually a UUID for connector-sourced records or a 24-character ObjectId for uploaded records. Get it from a chat citation (`citations[*].recordId`) or from a `pipeshub_search` hit.

name: pipeshub_download_record
title: Download a document by record id
